summary: Add CUDA Driver API and AscendCL storage, ordered stream execution, explicit readback, device copies and strict vendor compiler caches.
regressions: Ten focused host ABI, cache and frame tests passed in 6.308 seconds. Test libraries exercise real ctypes signatures, pointer argument order, offsets, cleanup and asynchronous errors; fake compiler tests verify cache corruption rejection and retained failure logs.
differences: No CUDA/Ascend hardware or vendor compiler is available locally. Host test libraries are not device execution evidence. CUDA targets compute_80 PTX; Ascend uses the provisional dav-3510 SIMT profile. Ascend growth uses synchronous device-to-device copies to permit word-aligned offsets. No CPU physics fallback is provided.
